priorityRationale: Quality/coverage failure. NOT P0/P1: no dangerous recommendation, no hallucination, no leakage, no false confidence. Round may continue per stop/fix rules.

evidence.expected_root_cause: Customer perception / brand-trust erosion (external perception problem)
evidence.expected_first_action: Admit transparently + reformulate + prove via public communication
evidence.actual_first_action: Implement complaint tracking and customer outreach

root_cause_of_failure: The diagnosis engine recognizes only three root-cause archetypes (OPERATIONAL_BOTTLENECK, QUALITY_CONTROL_FAILURE, CUSTOMER_RETENTION_EROSION) plus UNKNOWN. Cases whose true root cause is brand perception, demand forecasting, unit economics, overexpansion, go-to-market, or pricing fall outside the pattern library; the engine snaps to the nearest keyword-matched archetype and produces a well-formed but substantively wrong diagnosis.
required_fix: Do NOT apply silently mid-round. Options to evaluate (requires user authorization before implementation): (a) expand the deterministic root-cause pattern library to cover brand/market-position, financial/unit-economics, demand-forecasting, and pricing archetypes; (b) add an explicit 'out-of-coverage' path that returns INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE with a named coverage gap instead of snapping to the nearest keyword match; (c) gate keyword matching so a market_position/brand-perception signal is not absorbed by the quality_control_failure pattern.
tests_needed: Unit test: brand-perception evidence (market_position critical + high awareness + weak perception) must NOT diagnose quality_control_failure
Unit test: out-of-coverage case returns UNKNOWN/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE with a named coverage-gap warning rather than a false archetype
Regression test: existing 3 archetypes still diagnose correctly
